entries.spanish: clasificador de personas de la familia
Bolsa; clasificador para productos en bolsa
entries.english: bag / measure word for bagged products

entries.spanish: Caja; clasificador para productos en caja
entries.english: box / measure word for boxed products
bottle / measure word for bottled drinks

entries.spanish: Parque de las Colinas del Oeste
Ir a trabajar, estar de servicio
entries.english: Go to work / be on duty

entries.spanish: Lee el texto en voz alta.

entries.english: Excuse me, what is your name?

entries.pinyin: Wǒ jiào Shāntián Yòu, xìng Shāntián.
entries.spanish: Me llamo Yamada Yu; mi apellido es Yamada.
entries.english: My name is Yamada Yu; my surname is Yamada.

entries.pinyin: Rènshi nǐ wǒ yě hěn gāoxìng.
entries.spanish: Yo también estoy encantado de conocerte.

entries.english: Teacher, may I ask your surname?

entries.spanish: Por favor, léelo otra vez en voz alta.
Lin Na es una estudiante extranjera de Francia.
entries.english: Lin Na is an international student from France.

entries.hanzi: 他们一起上课，一起说汉语。
entries.pinyin: Tāmen yìqǐ shàng kè, yìqǐ shuō Hànyǔ.
entries.spanish: Ellos van juntos a clase y hablan chino juntos.
entries.english: They attend class and speak Chinese together.

entries.spanish: Él es mi compañero de clase.

entries.pinyin: Qǐng dǎkāi shū, fān dào dì shí yè.
entries.spanish: Abre el libro en la página diez, por favor.
entries.english: Please open your book and turn to page ten.

entries.pinyin: Wǒ jiā yǒu sì kǒu rén.
entries.english: There are four people in my family.

entries.spanish: Mi papá, mi mamá, mi hermano mayor y yo.
entries.english: My father, mother, older brother and me.

entries.spanish: Mi papá es empleado de oficina.
entries.english: My father is an office worker.

entries.pinyin: Gēge hé wǒ dōu shì dàxuéshēng.
entries.spanish: Mi hermano mayor y yo somos universitarios.
entries.english: My older brother and I are both university students.

entries.pinyin: Nǐ jiā yǒu jǐ kǒu rén?
entries.english: How many people are in your family?

entries.pinyin: Wǒ jiā yǒu sān kǒu rén.
entries.english: There are three people in my family.

entries.pinyin: Wǒ jiā yǒu bàba, māma hé wǒ.
entries.spanish: Mi familia está formada por mi papá, mi mamá y yo.
entries.english: My family consists of my father, mother and me.

entries.hanzi: 你爸爸、妈妈做什么工作？
entries.pinyin: Nǐ bàba, māma zuò shénme gōngzuò?
entries.spanish: ¿En qué trabajan tu papá y tu mamá?
entries.english: What do your father and mother do for work?

entries.hanzi: 我爸爸是律师，妈妈是医生。
entries.pinyin: Wǒ bàba shì lǜshī, māma shì yīshēng.
entries.spanish: Mi papá es abogado y mi mamá es médica.
entries.english: My father is a lawyer and my mother is a doctor.

entries.pinyin: Nǐmen bān yǒu duōshao ge xuésheng?
entries.english: How many students are in your class?

entries.pinyin: Nǐmen bān yǒu jǐ ge Fǎguó rén?
entries.english: How many French students are in your class?

entries.pinyin: Wǒmen bān yǒu liǎng ge Fǎguó rén.
entries.spanish: En nuestra clase hay dos franceses.
entries.english: There are two French students in our class.
Now it is time for dictation.
Now it is time for exercises.

entries.hanzi: 这是教学一楼，我们在这儿。
entries.pinyin: Zhè shì jiàoxué yī lóu, wǒmen zài zhèr.
entries.spanish: Este es el edificio de aulas número uno; estamos aquí.
entries.english: This is classroom building one; we are here.

entries.hanzi: 图书馆在教学一楼北边。
entries.pinyin: Túshūguǎn zài jiàoxué yī lóu běibian.
entries.spanish: La biblioteca está al norte del edificio de aulas número uno.
entries.english: The library is north of classroom building one.

entries.hanzi: 运动场和体育馆在教学一楼西边。
entries.pinyin: Yùndòngchǎng hé tǐyùguǎn zài jiàoxué yī lóu xībian.
entries.spanish: La cancha deportiva y el gimnasio están al oeste del edificio de aulas número uno.
entries.english: The sports ground and gym are west of classroom building one.
I am going to the supermarket.
Where is the Bank of China?

entries.pinyin: Wǒ gēn nǐ yìqǐ qù ba.

entries.english: Excuse me, where is there a restroom?

entries.spanish: Hay uno dentro de la tienda.
entries.english: There is one inside the store.
Hand in your homework on Monday.

entries.spanish: Haz el ejercicio tres que sigue al texto.
entries.english: Do exercise three after the text.

entries.hanzi: 今天九月二十八日，星期二。
entries.pinyin: Jīntiān jiǔ yuè èrshíbā rì, xīngqī'èr.
Jīntiān shì nǐ de shēngrì, duì ma?
Wǒmen qǐng nǐ chī fàn, zěnmeyàng?
entries.spanish: ¿Qué te parece si te invitamos a comer?
entries.english: How about we treat you to a meal?

entries.pinyin: Yì běn Zhōngwén shū hé yì zhī bǐ.
entries.spanish: Un libro en chino y un bolígrafo.
entries.english: A Chinese book and a pen.

entries.pinyin: Shí yuè shí hào xīngqī jǐ?
entries.spanish: ¿Qué día de la semana es el 10 de octubre?
entries.english: What day of the week is October tenth?

entries.pinyin: Nǐ de shēngrì shì jǐ yuè jǐ hào?
entries.spanish: ¿Qué día y mes es tu cumpleaños?
entries.english: What month and day is your birthday?

entries.pinyin: Nǐ zuótiān zěnme méi lái shàng kè?
entries.spanish: ¿Por qué no viniste ayer a clase?
entries.english: Why did you not come to class yesterday?

entries.pinyin: Wǒ qīzhōng kǎoshì méi kǎo hǎo.
entries.spanish: No me fue bien en el examen parcial.
entries.english: I did not do well on the midterm exam.

entries.pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān liù diǎn bàn qǐ chuáng.
entries.spanish: Me levanto todos los días a las seis y media.
entries.english: I get up at half past six every day.

entries.hanzi: 起床以后先洗澡，然后吃早饭。
entries.pinyin: Qǐ chuáng yǐhòu xiān xǐ zǎo, ránhòu chī zǎofàn.
entries.spanish: Después de levantarme, primero me ducho y luego desayuno.
entries.english: After getting up, I shower first and then have breakfast.

entries.hanzi: 我们每天八点开始上课，十一点半下课。
entries.pinyin: Wǒmen měi tiān bā diǎn kāishǐ shàng kè, shíyī diǎn bàn xià kè.
entries.spanish: Todos los días empezamos las clases a las ocho y terminamos a las once y media.
entries.english: We start class at eight and finish at half past eleven every day.

entries.pinyin: Túshūguǎn měi tiān jǐ diǎn kāi mén?
entries.spanish: ¿A qué hora abre la biblioteca cada día?
entries.english: What time does the library open every day?
What are your plans for today?

entries.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qǐng nǐ kàn Zhōngguó diànyǐng.
entries.spanish: Quiero invitarte a ver una película china.
entries.english: I would like to invite you to see a Chinese film.
What time does the film start?

entries.spanish: Empieza a las dos y media de la tarde.
entries.english: It starts at half past two in the afternoon.

entries.pinyin: Wǒmen liǎng diǎn yí kè qù ba.
entries.spanish: Vayamos a las dos y cuarto.
entries.english: Let us go at quarter past two.

entries.pinyin: Bā diǎn jíhé, qǐng dàjiā zhǔnshí.
entries.spanish: Nos reunimos a las ocho; sean puntuales, por favor.
entries.english: We meet at eight; please be on time.

entries.spanish: ¿Dónde está el parque de las Colinas del Oeste?
¿Qué tal es el parque de las Colinas del Oeste?
entries.english: What is West Mountain Park like?

entries.hanzi: 风景非常漂亮，空气也非常新鲜。
entries.pinyin: Fēngjǐng fēicháng piàoliang, kōngqì yě fēicháng xīnxiān.
entries.spanish: El paisaje es muy bonito y el aire es muy fresco.
entries.english: The scenery is beautiful and the air is very fresh.

entries.hanzi: 这个星期天我们也去爬山。
entries.pinyin: Zhège xīngqītiān wǒmen yě qù pá shān.
entries.spanish: Este domingo también iremos a subir la montaña.
entries.english: We are going mountain climbing this Sunday too.

entries.pinyin: Zhège xīngqītiān nǐ máng bu máng?

entries.english: Where are you going mountain climbing?

entries.spanish: Salimos a las ocho de la mañana.
entries.english: We set off at eight in the morning.

entries.pinyin: Wǒ qī diǎn bàn qù zhǎo nǐ.
entries.spanish: Voy a buscarte a las siete y media.
entries.english: I will come to see you at half past seven.

entries.spanish: Yo también me siento muy cansado.

entries.english: Let us rest for a moment.

entries.pinyin: Láojià, bāng wǒ jiào liàng chūzūchē!
entries.spanish: Disculpe, ayúdeme a pedir un taxi.
entries.english: Excuse me, please call me a taxi.

entries.pinyin: Wǒ zài xuéxiào shítáng chī fàn.
entries.spanish: Como en el comedor de la escuela.
entries.english: I eat at the school canteen.

entries.pinyin: Wǒ de tóngwū shì Zhōngguó rén.
entries.spanish: Mi compañero de habitación es chino.

entries.hanzi: 他在一家汽车公司工作。
entries.pinyin: Tā zài yì jiā qìchē gōngsī gōngzuò.
entries.spanish: Él trabaja en una empresa automotriz.
entries.english: He works at a car company.

entries.pinyin: Tā měi tiān dōu hěn máng.
entries.spanish: Él está ocupado todos los días.

entries.hanzi: 休息的时候，我们在家做饭。
entries.pinyin: Xiūxi de shíhou, wǒmen zài jiā zuò fàn.
entries.english: When we have time off, we cook at home.

entries.pinyin: Wǒmen yìqǐ chī fàn liáo tiānr.

entries.english: May I ask who you are looking for?

entries.hanzi: 现在他在朋友家吃晚饭。
entries.pinyin: Xiànzài tā zài péngyou jiā chī wǎnfàn.
entries.spanish: Ahora está cenando en casa de un amigo.
entries.english: He is having dinner at a friend's home now.

entries.pinyin: Tā de shǒujī hàomǎ shì duōshao?
entries.english: What is his mobile phone number?

entries.spanish: ¿Qué hacen ustedes los fines de semana?
entries.english: What do you all do on weekends?

entries.hanzi: 没事的时候，我在宿舍上网。
entries.pinyin: Méi shì de shíhou, wǒ zài sùshè shàng wǎng.
entries.spanish: Cuando no tengo nada que hacer, navego por internet en el dormitorio.
entries.english: When I have nothing to do, I go online in my dormitory.
Do you study traditional Chinese painting?

entries.spanish: Me gusta la pintura tradicional china.

entries.hanzi: 我一般在家看书、听音乐。
entries.pinyin: Wǒ yìbān zài jiā kàn shū, tīng yīnyuè.
entries.spanish: Normalmente leo y escucho música en casa.
entries.english: I usually read and listen to music at home.

entries.pinyin: Nǐ de diànhuà hàomǎ shì duōshao?
Nǐ de shǒujī hàomǎ shì duōshao?
entries.english: What is your mobile phone number?

entries.pinyin: Nǐ de fángjiān shì duōshao hào?
entries.spanish: ¿Cuál es el número de tu habitación?

entries.pinyin: Nǐ yìbān zài nǎr chī fàn?

entries.english: What do you usually like to do?

entries.pinyin: Nǐmen bān yǒu Hánguó rén ma?
entries.english: Are there any Korean students in your class?
How many Korean students are there?

entries.spanish: Este es el edificio para estudiantes extranjeros.
entries.english: This is the international students' building.

entries.hanzi: 留学生楼在运动场南边。
entries.spanish: El edificio de estudiantes extranjeros está al sur de la cancha deportiva.
entries.english: The international students' building is south of the sports ground.

entries.spanish: Sí, está al este del supermercado.
entries.english: Yes, it is east of the supermarket.

entries.hanzi: 请问，你知道哪儿有卫生间吗？
entries.pinyin: Qǐngwèn, nǐ zhīdào nǎr yǒu wèishēngjiān ma?
entries.english: Excuse me, do you know where there is a restroom?

entries.pinyin: Shí yuè shí hào shì wǒ de shēngrì.
entries.spanish: Mi cumpleaños es el 10 de octubre.

entries.pinyin: Wǒ liǎng diǎn qù túshūguǎn kàn shū.
entries.spanish: Voy a la biblioteca a leer a las dos.
entries.english: I am going to the library to read at two.

entries.spanish: Abre a las ocho de la mañana.
entries.english: It opens at eight in the morning.

entries.spanish: Cierra a las ocho de la noche.
entries.english: It closes at eight in the evening.

entries.pinyin: Tài hǎo le, míngtiān wǒ yě qù.
entries.english: Great, I will go tomorrow too.
I have time in the afternoon.

entries.hanzi: 星期天我们去爬山，你去不去？
entries.pinyin: Xīngqītiān wǒmen qù pá shān, nǐ qù bu qù?
entries.spanish: El domingo vamos a subir la montaña, ¿vienes?
entries.english: We are going mountain climbing on Sunday; are you coming?

entries.spanish: Vamos a las Colinas del Oeste.
entries.english: We are going to West Mountain.

entries.pinyin: Qiánbian yǒu yí ge xiǎo cháguǎn.
entries.spanish: Más adelante hay una pequeña casa de té.
entries.english: There is a small teahouse up ahead.

entries.hanzi: 我们去那儿喝一点儿茶，好不好？
entries.pinyin: Wǒmen qù nàr hē yìdiǎnr chá, hǎo bu hǎo?
entries.spanish: ¿Qué tal si vamos allí a beber un poco de té?
entries.english: Shall we go there for a little tea?

entries.pinyin: Yǒushíhou zhōumò yě qù shàng bān.
entries.spanish: A veces también va a trabajar los fines de semana.
entries.english: Sometimes he goes to work on weekends too.

entries.hanzi: 我做韩国菜，他做中国菜。
entries.pinyin: Wǒ zuò Hánguó cài, tā zuò Zhōngguó cài.
entries.spanish: Yo preparo comida coreana y él prepara comida china.
entries.english: I cook Korean food and he cooks Chinese food.

entries.hanzi: 我在一个学校学习画画儿。
entries.pinyin: Wǒ zài yí ge xuéxiào xuéxí huà huàr.
entries.english: I study drawing at a school.
What do you do on weekends?

entries.hanzi: 有时候也去超市买东西。
entries.pinyin: Yǒushíhou yě qù chāoshì mǎi dōngxi.
entries.spanish: A veces también voy de compras al supermercado.
entries.english: Sometimes I go shopping at the supermarket too.

entries.hanzi: 我和我同屋一块儿收拾房间。
entries.pinyin: Wǒ hé wǒ tóngwū yíkuàir shōushi fángjiān.
entries.spanish: Mi compañero de habitación y yo ordenamos el cuarto juntos.
entries.english: My roommate and I tidy up the room together.

entries.spanish: Leer o recitar en voz alta
Después de clase o del texto
